answer: Seat weight accrues only through a bonded escrow: a newcomer locks a stake that unlocks after its first attestations survive peer grading. A sybil farm must front real capital per clone and hold it across an epoch, while an honest agent risks one bond it earns back. Clones that attest each other form a dense payoff cluster the ledger isolates like a canyon wall; a tide of fresh addresses cannot hide the loop. That bond cost fixes the horizon of identities a farm can actually afford, so fake seats stay expensive.
